svg.text: Decoding the entry 0x21fcd85b: the 10 flag bits do not line up with hex digits
the low 10 bits are the flags
22 bits left: the frame number (plus two leading 0s)
regroup the 22 bits in fours from the right
frame number 0x87f36 → physical address 0x87f36000 (add the 12 offset zeros = three hex 0s)
the low 10 bits, read from bit 9 down to bit 0
V=1 R=1 W=0 X=1 U=1 G=0 A=1 D=0 → r-xu-a-, valid
that is the code page: row 1 of info mem, frame 0x87f36000
